_note_nl: Wat je ziet: de pagina Rapporten: drie rapporten in twee categorieën.
Kies een rapport om het te openen · 4 ra: Pick a report to open it · 4 reports in 3 categories
Wat gepubliceerd is, wat gearchiveerd is: What is published, what is archived, and what the retention period prescribes as the next step.
Waar mensen naar keken en wat ze downloa: What people looked at and what they downloaded.
Hoe volwassen de catalogi zijn, en hoe d: How mature the catalogues are, and how deeply the directory listings are integrated.
Hoeveel documenten elke beoordelaar per: How many documents each reviewer assessed per day, per Woo case or per period. Only for the group the administrator names.
beoordelingen per beoordelaar per dag, i: assessments per reviewer per day, in this instance's time zone · only for members of woo-leiding · every read is recorded with reader, time and scope
Wie niet in woo-leiding zit, ook een beh: Anyone outside woo-leiding, an administrator too, sees instead of the table: "You have no access to this report. Only members of woo-leiding read the counts per reviewer."
Weergaven en downloads tellen we op de o: We count views and downloads on the public addresses, as daily totals. We store no visitor data, and known bots do not count.
